sentences.en: The political scandal was brought to light by two journalists.
sentences.zh: 两位记者揭露了这场政治丑闻。

sentences.en: The magazine jumped the gun and reported on the scandal.
sentences.zh: 这本杂志提前报道了这场丑闻。

sentences.en: The scandal robbed him of a chance to become President.
sentences.zh: 这场丑闻让他失去了成为总统的机会。
